title: What are you doing this week?
content_html:
I've been doing some intensive cleaning. (Pulling out and rewiring everything two computers and networking gear from the two desks I use, plus the same thing on the TV furniture piece that held also quite a lot of hardware.)

I quit my job some weeks ago as I'm quite unhappy with the job market in general and I start the master's degree that's required here to teach secondary school.

However, an ex-colleague convinced me to apply to his company, which apparently would not be as horrible as most other jobs I'm seeing. I'm doing a third interview in 10 minutes.

I have a long list of stuff I'd be supposed to do with free time, yet the main thing I've worked on lately has been my minimalistic personal website and... starting to implement some kind of Nagios bizarre clone (toying with experimenting with DuckDB as a storage backend).

I'm also setting up a mini PC with AMD graphics for the TV. For now I configured Tvheadend so I can do some occasional TV recording (DVB-T public broadcast- they still air interesting movies and shows from time to time). Now I want to set up Steam Big Picture, but that's a bit more of a pain than I expected on Debian. I've recovered the original Steam Controller, which now seems to provide pointer control OOB, so perhaps I'll try with that with a quite-vanilla desktop setup.
